current_sprint_goal: All planned phases complete. Pending: file transfer ops, multi-window, theming.

Phase 0.summary: All source files, Electron config, Vite, Tailwind, TypeScript scaffolded and pushed to GitHub.

Phase 1.summary: Renderer and main process now share a single live data path. All mock data removed. ssh:write fire-and-forget, resize debounced, SSHConnectionPool double-disconnect fixed.
changes: src/main/preload.ts — ssh.connect(sessionId: string) replaces raw config object
src/renderer/types.d.ts — SessionNode interface added globally; sessions IPC fully typed; ssh.write return type void
src/renderer/components/SessionTree.tsx — loads from sessions:getNodes IPC on mount; add/delete wired to IPC; two-click delete confirmation; loading/empty states; no window.prompt()
src/renderer/index.tsx — handleConnect passes session.id; hardcoded password_placeholder removed; handleConnectionError added
src/renderer/components/TerminalTabs.tsx — onConnectionError prop added; subscribes to ssh.onError alongside ssh.onData; both cleaned up together on tab close/unmount

Phase 2.summary: VaultUnlockModal shown on startup. saltHex persisted in localStorage. Header badge is reactive (amber locked / emerald unlocked). Clicking locked badge re-opens modal.
changes: src/renderer/components/VaultUnlockModal.tsx — NEW: master password input, calls vault:unlock, stores saltHex, inline error, Skip button
src/renderer/index.tsx — added vaultUnlocked + showVaultModal state; useEffect checks vault.isUnlocked() on mount; header badge reactive; modal rendered at root level

bug_fixes_applied.ssh_write_freeze: Changed ssh:write from ipcRenderer.invoke to ipcRenderer.send (fire-and-forget). ipcMain.on replaces ipcMain.handle. Prevents Promise queue buildup on rapid keystrokes.
bug_fixes_applied.resize_no_debounce: Added 100ms debounce to ResizeObserver + window.resize handler in TerminalTabs.tsx.
bug_fixes_applied.double_disconnect: SSHConnectionPool.disconnect() deletes from Map before ending channel/client. channel.on('close') and client.on('close') are now re-entry-safe.
bug_fixes_applied.cpu_features_freeze: stubs/cpu-features/ no-op stub added. package.json overrides cpu-features to file:./stubs/cpu-features. Prevents node-gyp C++ compilation on npm install.

known_gaps_and_blockers.vault_not_unlocked: RESOLVED in Phase 2. VaultUnlockModal shown on startup, saltHex persisted in localStorage. SSH credential auth now functional.
known_gaps_and_blockers.session_crud_no_form: SessionTree + button creates a placeholder session (name: 'New Session', host: 'hostname'). Full CRUD form is Phase 3.
known_gaps_and_blockers.sftp_uses_alert: RESOLVED in Phase 4. SftpPanel.tsx renders a real overlay with directory listing and navigation.
known_gaps_and_blockers.terminal_hardcoded_80x24: RESOLVED in Phase 4. TerminalTabs fires ssh.resize immediately after fit.fit() on first mount, syncing PTY to actual xterm cols/rows. Initial 80x24 is transient.

architecture_invariants: Renderer NEVER imports Node.js APIs. All system calls go through contextBridge in preload.ts.
ssh:write uses ipcRenderer.send (fire-and-forget) — never revert to invoke.
cpu-features override in package.json must not be removed — prevents node-gyp freeze on npm install.
SSHConnectionPool.disconnect() must delete from Map BEFORE calling channel/client end.
